keyword: buy diesel concrete pump without grid power

title.en: Without a Stable Grid, Start on Xingtai’s Diesel Catalogue
title.zh: 没有稳定电网时，先打开邢台的柴油目录

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai tells buyers with no stable grid to open diesel trailer pumps, the rural diesel pump or the tractor-driven pump. Do not copy an electric kilowatt onto those pages.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台让没有稳定电网的买家先看柴油拖泵、农村柴油泵或拖拉机带动泵。不要把电动千瓦抄到这些页上。

h1.en: No Stable Grid: Open the Diesel Catalogue First
h1.zh: 没有稳定电网：先打开柴油目录

directAnswer.en: If the site has no stable supply for a listed electric motor, Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai says to start on the diesel catalogue. That set includes Diesel 30 through Diesel 120, LZ-60, LZ-80, Tractor-Driven 4100 and the rural 17 kW diesel pump. Read the engine line on the page you open. Diesel 30 is 4105 / 56 kW and 15 m³/h. The rural pump is 17 kW and 5–8 m³/h. They are not interchangeable orders.
directAnswer.zh: 如果现场没有稳定供电去带一台已列电机，河北品锦机械（邢台）的口径是先看柴油目录。这一组包括柴油30到柴油120、LZ-60、LZ-80、拖拉机带动4100和农村 17 kW 柴油泵。读你打开的那一页上的发动机行。柴油30是 4105 / 56 kW、15 m³/h。农村泵是 17 kW、5–8 m³/h。它们不是可以互换的订单。

heading.en: Which light diesel row is not Diesel 30?
heading.zh: 哪条轻型柴油行不是柴油30？

body.en: The rural diesel pump prints 17 kW, 5–8 m³/h, 15 MPa, 30–50 m horizontal, 10–30 m vertical, hopper 0.2 m³ and 800 kg. Diesel 30 prints 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 20 MPa, 60 m / 180 m and 2000 kg. Open [/en/products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump/](/en/products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump/) before you write “diesel 30” on a small order.
body.zh: 农村柴油泵印 17 kW、5–8 m³/h、15 MPa、水平 30–50 m、垂直 10–30 m、料斗 0.2 m³、800 kg。柴油30印 56 kW、15 m³/h、20 MPa、60 m / 180 m、2000 kg。小型订单写下“柴油30”之前，先打开 [/zh/products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump/](/zh/products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump/)。

heading.en: What the tractor page is for
heading.zh: 拖拉机页用来采购什么

body.en: Tractor-Driven 4100 prints 40 kW, 6–12 m³/h, 15 MPa, 40–100 m / 15–45 m, aggregate 1–3 cm, hopper 0.25 m³, slump 180–220 mm and 1300 kg. Order it when the drive is the tractor arrangement on that sheet, not when you wanted a 4105 diesel trailer.
body.zh: 拖拉机带动4100印 40 kW、6–12 m³/h、15 MPa、40–100 m / 15–45 m、骨料 1–3 cm、料斗 0.25 m³、坍落度 180–220 mm、1300 kg。驱动方式就是该页的拖拉机方案时才订它，不是你本来要 4105 柴油拖泵的时候。

heading.en: Inquiry line for an off-grid order
heading.zh: 无电网订单的询盘一行

body.en: Write “diesel”, the engine or 17 kW rural line, maximum stone, required output and both distances. Send it to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/). Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not print fuel consumption or a tank volume on these buying sheets.
body.zh: 写上“柴油”、发动机或农村 17 kW 那一行、最大石子、目标输送量和两个方向的距离。发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。河北品锦机械不在这些采购页上印油耗或油箱容积。

question.en: Can I paste Electric 80 onto a site with no grid?
question.zh: 没有电网时能把电动80抄过去吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 80 prints a 110 kW motor. Without a supply for that motor, open a diesel page such as Diesel 120 or LZ-80 and read that page’s own cells.
answer.zh: 不能。电动80印的是 110 kW 电机。没有对应供电时，打开柴油120或 LZ-80，读那一页自己的格子。

question.en: Does “no grid” mean the rural 17 kW pump only?
question.zh: 没有电网是不是只有农村 17 kW 泵？

answer.en: No. The rural pump is the light row. Larger diesel trailers are listed separately.
answer.zh: 不是。农村泵是轻型行。更大的柴油拖泵另行列出。

answer.en: No. Do not add a litres-per-hour figure. It is not on these sheets.
answer.zh: 没有。不要自加每小时升数。这些表上没有。

answer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, through the contact page. No list price is printed.
answer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台），通过询盘页。不印标价。
